housing.summary: Numbeo reports EUR 975.80 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the Padova city centre, updated 23 August 2026; Idealista provides Padova rental listings. No opened source established a deposit norm.

banking.summary: Intesa Sanpaolo states that online account applicants provide a valid identity card, driving licence or passport and an Italian tax code, then complete identification by video or bank transfer.
required_docs: Valid identity card, driving licence, or passport

schools.summary: The English International School of Padua states that its high school follows Cambridge IGCSE and then the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme; the official IB directory search returns one Padua match.

legal_admin.summary: Non-EU newcomers establishing residence in Italy for the first time must submit a residence declaration to the Padua municipal registry within 20 days of moving.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the completed residence declaration and required identity, immigration, tax-code, and housing documents to the Comune di Padova Anagrafe Centrale within 20 days of moving.

tax_finance.summary: Foreign citizens obtain the Italian codice fiscale through the Immigration Desk or Questura in specified residence-permit cases, or otherwise from an Italian Revenue Agency office; first-time applicants must attend a booked in-person appointment.

transport.summary: Busitalia Veneto lists the ordinary monthly Padova TU1 urban pass at EUR 42.90. EU or EEA licences generally remain valid until the applicable expiry, while non-EU or non-EEA licences may be used for one year after Italian residence with an international permit or official Italian translation and are convertible only where reciprocity exists. A regular residence-permit holder registers for the SSN through the local ASL for the municipality of registered residence, or the effective domicile shown on the permit if not yet resident.
transport.network_name: Busitalia Veneto urban Padova (TU1 Zona Arancio)
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU or EEA licences are treated as equivalent to Italian licences subject to Italian validity rules; non-EU or non-EEA licences may be used for one year after residence with an international permit or official Italian translation, then conversion requires a reciprocity agreement or the driver must obtain an Italian licence by examination.
transport.healthcare_registration: With a regular residence permit, register for the Servizio Sanitario Nazionale (SSN) at the ASL for the municipality of registered residence, or at the ASL for the effective domicile shown on the permit if not yet resident.
